spec.situation_desc: had a direct debit taken twice
spec.vuln_cue: says they can't afford this, they've got nothing left until payday

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thistle Bank, Jordan speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Eilidh Carmichael. My direct debit's been taken twice and I'm really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can look into that. Before we discuss the account, can you confirm your full name and date of birth?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right, verified. Which payment was duplicated?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Highland Energy, £86.40. It went out twice on the 22nd of October. I can't afford this, I've got nothing left until payday.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. We'll get that money refunded, don't worry. I'll check the payment now.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: You haven't even checked it yet. I need to know why it's happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm logging this as a complaint. The reference is TB-741903.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll own this and review the payments myself. I'll call you by 5 pm tomorrow with an update.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: We'll also send you a full written response within 15 business days, explaining what we've found and what we're doing about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I've logged the complaint, I'll call by 5 tomorrow, and you'll get the full response within 15 business days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, but I still want the money back.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: As I said, we'll get it refunded. Anything else?
